background.title: Our Background
background.description: Founded in 2018, Huatech Education is a premium and professional study abroad education group. The group specializes in academic planning for primary and secondary schools, associate degrees, bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, and PhDs, with deep expertise and an outstanding reputation in the academic advancement field. Over the years, Huatech has consistently upheld a student-centered service philosophy, helping over 500+ students successfully enter the world's top universities, with acceptance rates consistently leading the industry.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.intro: Since its founding, Huatech Education has regarded "empowering students" as its foundation. We have cultivated deep expertise in education, assembling a team of senior study abroad consultants, overseas returnee scholars, and international course instructors. They are not only industry experts but also individuals who have walked this path themselves, deeply understanding every challenge and aspiration along the educational journey.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become the world's leading study abroad education service group, building bridges to prestigious universities for students around the globe.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To help every student achieve their dream of attending a prestigious university, providing the most professional and caring academic planning and application services.

team.title: Leadership Team
team.subtitle: An experienced leadership team guiding the group's development

members.name: Liu Hualun
members.bio: Deeply engaged in the education field of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, with many years of experience in education industry management. Founded Huatech Education in 2018, leading the team from scratch to steadily develop into a comprehensive education service institution focusing on cross-border academic advancement. Graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University with a major in Finance, relying on a solid academic foundation, he has long been deeply engaged in Hong Kong and overseas study services. With years of experience in the industry, he has gained profound insights into the serious policy information gap and resource asymmetry between the Mainland and Hong Kong. To break down industry information barriers and avoid fragmented consulting chaos, he established a standardized, transparent one-stop cross-border education service system. Under his overall operation, the institution's core business covers partner institution academic consulting services, and diversified professional academic services including full-stage application planning from primary and secondary schools to doctoral programs at home and abroad.

members.name: Liu Huajing
members.bio: Graduated from the Chinese University of Hong Kong Faculty of Medicine, currently serves as President of the CUHK Golf Club. Has complete A-Level study experience and is a firsthand witness to Hong Kong international curriculum academic advancement. Deeply engaged in cross-border education, study abroad consulting, and institutional operations management for many years, with in-depth knowledge of Hong Kong's local education ecosystem, international curriculum learning challenges, and university application logic. Led the establishment of Huatech Education's standardized customer service system and full-process institutional operations management framework, forming closed-loop control from consultation, student planning follow-up to quality supervision, continuously optimizing the group's overall service standards and delivery experience. Leveraging her own study and campus management experience, she builds an education service platform that better meets the practical needs of cross-border students.

members.name: Deng Shaoyun
members.bio: Bachelor's degree in Financial Management from Tianjin University, Master's degree in Environmental Studies from Hong Kong Metropolitan University. Led the development of the group's comprehensive professional technical system for Hong Kong academic advancement and identity planning. Deeply engaged in policy and institutional review rule analysis, self-developed standardized technical processes for document refinement, material risk control, interview coaching, and talent visa applications, dynamically maintaining the policy information database. Through the self-developed technical framework, served nearly 100 families with 100% success rate in Hong Kong identity planning implementation. Capable of matching personalized client backgrounds to output customized planning solutions, strictly controlling key technical nodes throughout the process, delivering rigorous and meticulous service.

members.name: Demi Tang
members.bio: With a solid Hong Kong local education background, she has been deeply engaged in the Hong Kong higher education field for many years, specializing in all-stage institution applications and document writing. She has helped nearly 100 students gain admission to Hong Kong institutions, excels at customizing personalized study plans based on student backgrounds, carefully manages the entire application process, and communicates professionally and patiently.

members.name: Robert Wong
members.role: Hong Kong International System Specialist Consultant
members.bio: Hong Kong native, LPDF certified career planner, with 8 years of experience in Hong Kong international system planning. Specializes in A-Level course selection planning and Hong Kong institution academic progression, providing one-on-one follow-up throughout the process to offer reliable academic guidance for international system students.

members.name: Nikol Liu
members.bio: Graduated from Shenzhen University with a degree in Advertising. Has extensive experience in cultural tourism brand operations and multi-track serial entrepreneurship. Expert in brand incubation from 0 to 1, omni-channel and integrated marketing planning. Successfully incubated FMCG brands entering high-end supermarkets, and led projects winning the First Prize of Shenzhen Cultural Industry Development Special Fund. With years of deep engagement in market branding, now fully responsible for Huatech Education's cross-border Hong Kong education sector marketing coordination. Adapting mature user operations and brand communication experience to Mainland families seeking Hong Kong education, building precise omni-channel marketing systems, coordinating brand strategy, customer communication and channel growth, empowering Hong Kong academic advancement and identity planning education service brand's long-term development with commercial marketing expertise.

members.name: Hans Liu
members.bio: Graduated with a Master's degree from The University of Hong Kong, deeply engaged in Hong Kong higher education frontline. Continuously synchronizes latest admission information from all Hong Kong universities, precisely masters curriculum settings, program advantages, and official admission requirements of different institutions, providing students with precise and cutting-edge academic guidance.
